algorithm:
Conservative fixed-source line map; compile/link qualification is separate.

Only byte-equal source spans count here. Changed but equivalent source is not
added, so no human equivalence judgment is disguised as an automated match.
The fourth-batch lower bound subtracts *all* prior reference ranges, including
references that were never claimed as integrated source, to avoid overlap.
mapping_boundary: Mapped source is not compiled/retained coverage. Qualification requires separate ordinary-main Release compile/link and native dispatcher/class/real-consumer evidence. No equivalent changed lines are counted; fourth new lower bound subtracts every earlier source reference range conservatively, rather than claiming reference text was integrated.
signed_ipa_boundary: Pending separate actual signed artifact verification; neither Android APK source nor the local unsigned iOS framework is attributed to a signed IPA.

ios.artifact_boundary: iOS framework/app only; signed IPA separately verified by PM

android.artifact_boundary: Android APK only; never attributed to iOS IPA

known_byte_equal_origin_sets.boundary: P is only verified byte-equal same-path baseline provenance under the same native source eligibility filter, not all previous batches or asserted old binary linkage. Cross-path/equivalent-derived baseline remains unknown. N is exact relative to known P only. References never form P; the extra reference-subtracted fourth-new lower bound is a separate non-additive quantity.

release_qualification.rule: Only primary executable native runtime core paths with current target SHA exactly matching unchanged ordinary Release build inputs are admitted. Headers, declaration-only, known no-caller network helpers, local adapters, resources, tests, Dart and release-excluded source lines do not count. This is module/source provenance, not a claim that each source line has a separate retained machine-code instruction or was individually executed.

native_entry_chains.android: GeneratedPluginRegistrant -> StminiFlutterPlugin.onAttachedToEngine/onMethodCall -> StminiContainerActivity/Home/WebPage and OnlineWebActivity; container -> MiniPackageStore, MiniLink, pool, overlay, StminiWebBridge and SharedOnlineWeb. Activities are retained manifest entry points; R8 mapping/dex evidence is platform-specific.
native_entry_chains.ios: GeneratedPluginRegistrant -> StminiFlutterPlugin.register/handle -> STWebOpenHandler and STWebMiniprogramCrl/H5/OnlineWebViewController -> STWebResourceManager, scheme handler, views/navigation/instance pool and STWebApiManager/SharedOnlineWeb. Runner dynamically loads the native framework; core exported types are retained.

release_qualification.artifact_boundary: Android source counts apply to APK only. iOS source counts apply to the local unsigned Runner.app/framework only; actual signed IPA is a separate PM gate.

ordinary_build_commands.ios: bundle exec flutter build ios --release --no-codesign --no-pub --target lib/main.dart

release_qualification.consumer_boundary: Controlled real native SDK/WebView/CMS consumers and native tests are distinct from ordinary Dart main/AOT and from signed IPA/device/store evidence. This map does not assert each method/source line was individually executed.

host_purpose_declarations.boundary: Camera/video and photo-read scanner APIs are compiled SDK references, not a Deynu startup scanner entry or an automatic permission request. Add-only applies to the explicit save path. No microphone purpose or audio recording is introduced.

runtime_validation_reuse.reason: Only host purpose strings, localized resources and resource project references changed. Native/Dart/Android/test/lock inputs exactly match the prior completed validation; current ordinary iOS Release packaging is newly verified.

full_sdk.both_platforms: A/B each17 checks, closedBoth; iOS lifecycle onlyA, Android onlyB

runtime_validation_reuse.boundary: No new camera or photo access execution, no physical-device claim, and no signed IPA ingest acceptance implied. Runtime methods and source counts are separate from host declarations.
